newsitem.title: SPAIN: Iberia sparks Spanish routes fares war.
newsitem.headline: Iberia sparks Spanish routes fares war.

text.p: Iberia's announcement last week that it was cutting fares on some of the main domestic trunk routes within Spain has prompted a swift response from its competitors, airline spokesmen said on Thursday.
The main national rivals Spanair and Air Europa have either cut their fares by similar amounts and with similar conditions attached or are preparing to do so.
The independent airlines are also threatening to complain to the European Commission about Iberia's tactics on the grounds that slashing fares amounts to misuse of state funding.

Iberia last week cut its lowest fares by 20 to 25 percent on routes such as Barcelona-Malaga or Madrid-Malaga and Madrid- Palma de Mallorca for return flights with minimum stays of four days and booked at least two days ahead.
The flag carrier maintains that it is now in profit and therefore free to embark on a fare war if it thinks this is commercially necessary.
